entries.title: Support Tickets
entries.details: You can now submit bug reports directly from the site. Tickets include a severity level, description, and belong to a specific tool. You can track the status of your ticket and reply with additional information. Tickets are visible to admins who can respond and resolve them.

entries.title: Report a Bug button
entries.details: A Report a Bug button is now available throughout the site. It opens a ticket form pre-filled with the relevant tool, making it quick to flag issues without leaving the page you're on.

entries.title: Admin: Support Ticket management
entries.details: Admins can view all submitted tickets, reply to members, update ticket status (Open, In Progress, Resolved), and filter by severity or tool. A Discord DM is sent to the configured support recipient when a new ticket is submitted or a member replies.

entries.title: Job Pay Rates
entries.details: Admins can now define pay rate tables that determine how job payments are calculated. Rates can be configured per job type and are used as the basis for member pay claims.

entries.title: Job Pay Claims
entries.details: Members can now submit pay claims against completed jobs. Claims are reviewed by admins and can be approved or rejected. Your claim history and current status are visible in the Jobs section of the Members area.

entries.title: Market: Stock Listings
entries.details: Sellers can now create stock-based listings backed by a quantity pool. Buyers can purchase one or more units from the same listing and the available quantity decrements automatically. Bundle and multi-unit sales are now fully supported.

entries.title: RM Browser
entries.details: Members granted the RM Browser privilege can now view and filter JOE raw material inventory across all factions. Results are filterable by material type and faction. This replaces the previous Jawanet workflow.

entries.title: Admin: Nav Preferences
entries.details: Admins can now customise and reorder their admin navigation, including pinning favourite sections for quick access.

entries.title: Tool Subscription Platform
entries.details: The backend infrastructure for the public Anarchy Industries tool subscription platform is now in place. Individual and faction subscription plans, seat tiers, deal management, and automated revocation are all operational.

entries.title: DroidBrain upload queue
entries.details: DroidBrain uploads are now processed through a background queue with index status tracking. Large uploads no longer block the UI and processing status is visible in the admin panel.

entries.title: Discord: Support ticket notifications
entries.details: The configured support recipient now receives a Discord DM when a new support ticket is submitted and when a member replies to an existing ticket. The notification includes the ticket ID, tool, severity, and the member's name.

entries.title: SWC Status Banner
entries.details: A site-wide banner now appears automatically when Star Wars Combine is detected as unavailable. The banner flashes at the top of every page and disappears as soon as SWC comes back online. Powered by Uptime Kuma monitoring.

entries.title: Discord: Message delete action
entries.details: The Discord outbox worker now supports a delete action, allowing previously sent Discord messages to be removed programmatically by the backend.
